title: 23 一缕香火作家书报君平安莫记挂1224 来客22
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: 数日后...
当慈喜听圆广说着那位小师叔表现时，他的眉头皱了起来，额上的皱纹也涌了起来。
他似有所感，摸了摸那些皱纹。
苦修禅法苦习武，不觉都老了...
可谁不想多活几年？
一本《香取经》，其中玄意无穷尽，必也藏有长生法。
极乐，长生，岂非人之追求？
僧人也是人，追求这些有什么不对？
“他当真这么说？”
“是啊，师父，小师叔说......一心不可两用，我醉心于此清修！你和我说武功作甚？莫要坏了我的求佛之心！”
圆广仿的惟妙惟肖，然后又道，“弟子还在某个月黑风高的晚上，特意支开了罗汉堂的值夜弟子，给小师叔制造机会...但小师叔却是没来。”
“他是不是不知道？”慈喜问。
圆广忙道：“他知道的，弟子确定，那日用的是集体法事的名号，且罗汉堂平日里亮着灯火，那晚熄灭了。黑灯瞎火，月黑风高，小师叔要来看早...早来......师父，你看我干什么？”
慈喜古怪地盯着他，然后反问出一句：“月黑风高，黑灯瞎火，你小师叔敢走那羊肠山道么？”
那山道...两侧无护栏，石阶破碎，若是一阵横风，一个脚滑，那就要滚下山去了。
圆广也醒悟了过来，猛然拍了下光头，憨笑道：“师父...我...咱们罗汉堂的哪个不会武功嘛。我实在是忘记考虑这点了。”
空气安静着...
圆广打破安静，笑道：“那师父，现在咱们该干嘛？”
慈喜问：“今日的午饭吃了么？若是吃完了，给你小师叔的饭菜送了么？若是送了，那今日的碗筷洗了么？”
“还不去？”
圆广退下。
慈喜安静地坐在蒲团上。
在玄心面前，他是个小和尚，可在这些罗汉堂的黄袍僧人面前，他也是大师。
禅讲平常心，平常便是修行。
慈喜深吸一口气，山腰一缕缕香火顺着窗隙钻入其中，强烈的刺激激的他心猿意马陡然生，无边的欲念滋生出来，旋即又斩去，化作身后阴影里那蟒煞的一部分。
旋即，低声的自喃响起。
“倒是我多虑了，李玄虽不是慈安，可也正因他不是慈安，他不懂武功，出生贫微，身为棉农，或许有几分机灵劲儿，却终究胆怯怕事，不敢一搏。换做我...”
慈喜淡淡笑了起来。
一座崖，一场雪都能成为一处狱。
纵嗅满城香火，却禁足于云间孤山。
他难道就没有半点儿意识到不对么？
既然如此，他应该知道自己存在利用价值，无论他做什么都不会死，既然如此...那还有什么不敢去做的？
《琉璃宝典》大大方方地放在那儿，他居然不敢去拿，着实怯懦。
content_en:
A few days later...
When Cixi heard Yuan Guang talk about the performance of the junior uncle, his brows wrinkled and the wrinkles on his forehead also rose.
He seemed to feel something and touched the wrinkles.
I practice Zen and martial arts hard, and I feel old before I know it...
But who doesn’t want to live a few more years?
A "Xiang Chou Sutra" contains endless mysterious meanings, and it must also contain the method of immortality.
Isn't it the pursuit of human beings to achieve bliss and immortality?
Monks are human beings too, what’s wrong with pursuing these things?
"Did he really say that?"
"Yes, Master, my little uncle said... You can't do two things with one mind. I am obsessed with this practice! Why are you telling me about martial arts? Don't destroy my desire to seek Buddha!"
Yuan Guang imitated it vividly, and then said, "On a dark and windy night, the disciple deliberately sent away the night watch disciples of Luohan Hall to create opportunities for the young master uncle... but the young master uncle did not come."
"Doesn't he know?" Cixi asked.
Yuan Guang hurriedly said: "He knows, the disciple is sure, that the name of the collective ritual was used that day, and the lights in the Luohan Hall are on on weekdays, but they were extinguished that night. The lights are dark, the moon is dark and the wind is high, the young master is coming to see you early... Come early... Master, what do you think I am doing?"
Cixi stared at him strangely, and then asked in reply: "The moon is dark and the wind is high, and the lights are dark and the fire is blinding. Does your little uncle dare to walk on the Yangchang Mountain Road?"
That mountain road... there are no guardrails on both sides, and the stone steps are broken. If there is a gust of wind and one foot slips, he will roll down the mountain.
Yuan Guang also came to his senses, suddenly patted his bald head, and said with a naive smile: "Master...I...who among us in Luohan Hall doesn't know martial arts? I really forgot to consider this."
The air is quiet...
Yuan Guang broke the silence and said with a smile: "Master, what should we do now?"
Cixi asked: "Have you eaten today's lunch? If you have eaten, have you given the food to your little uncle? If so, have you washed today's dishes?"
"No...not yet..."
"Still not going?"
"Yes!"
Yuan Guang retreated.
Cixi sat quietly on the futon.
In front of Xuan Xin, he is a little monk, but in front of these yellow-robed monks in Luohan Hall, he is also a master.
Zen talks about a normal mind, and being normal is practice.
Cixi took a deep breath, and wisps of incense from the mountainside penetrated through the window. The strong stimulation suddenly made his mind wander. Boundless desire grew out, and then it was cut away, turning into a part of the python in the shadow behind him.
Immediately, a low murmur sounded.
"It's just that I worry too much. Although Li Xuan is not Cian, it is precisely because he is not Cian. He does not know martial arts and was born poor. As a cotton farmer, he may be a bit clever, but he is ultimately timid and afraid of taking a chance. If it were me..."
Cixi smiled lightly.
A cliff or a snowfall can become a prison.
I can smell the incense all over the city, but I am confined to the lonely mountain among the clouds.
Didn't he realize at all that something was wrong?
In this case, he should know that he has value and that no matter what he does, he will not die. If that's the case...then what else can he not dare to do?
The "Glass Book" was placed there generously, but he didn't dare to pick it up. He was really cowardly.
